name: Fourier Domain Approximate Shading
definition: A method to approximate diffuse shading in the Fourier domain by expressing shading terms (linear, quadratic, cubic) as convolutions of the volume's Fourier transform F and frequency vectors, avoiding repeated 3D Fourier transforms of the shaded volume for constant light sources.
summary: Fourier Domain Approximate Shading computes diffuse shading in the frequency domain via convolutions, offering efficiency for constant light sources but lacking the relighting flexibility of spherical harmonics.
